'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Vikram Bali DS Tatooine: Jabba's Palace''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Vikram Bali]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|JP-D-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
